summary: The PR addresses the issue of HistGradientBoostingClassifier not working with string targets when early stopping is enabled. The fix seems appropriate and the additional test cases help verify the solution.

issues.description: The addition of new test files (`reproduce_error.py` and `test_edge_cases.py`) should be part of the main test suite, likely within an existing or new test module.
The conversion of integer-encoded labels back to string labels could be made more explicit with comments explaining why this step is necessary.
